:::{#def-linear-approximation-vector}
#### Linear approximation of a function of a vector, first-order Taylor approximation of a function of a vector

Let $f : \reals^p \to \reals$ have a [gradient](#def-vector-derivative) at $\vcoef$.
The **linear approximation** of $f$ at $\vcoef$
[@wikipedia_linear_approximation]
(also called the **first-order Taylor approximation**
or the **first-order Taylor expansion**)
is the function of a step $\stepvec \in \reals^p$

$$
\hat{f}_{\vcoef}(\stepvec) \eqdef f(\vcoef) + \dprod{\gradf{f}(\vcoef)}{\stepvec}.
$$ {#eq-linear-approximation-vector}

:::
